how_to_find: Open your fork on GitHub and read the date of the newest commit on the main page. Compare it with the dates below. You can also call the /health address of your Railway service. It shows a version number. VERIFY: the health version is hard-coded in server.js and package.json still shows 1.0.0.

versions.title: Read, search, label and draft-management tools (v1.3.0)
versions.summary: Newest commit 8b1368d on 2026-10-13. The commit message names v1.3.0. The create_draft tool is unchanged. The Apps Script file gas/McpActions.gs was added in commit 8f61f15 on the same day.

changes.text: Tools search_threads, get_thread, get_message, list_labels, list_drafts, get_draft, update_draft, delete_draft, create_reply_draft and label_thread.
Apps Script file gas/McpActions.gs. It needs a Script Property named MCP_SECRET.

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: On GitHub, open your fork and choose Sync fork. Railway redeploys by itself.

upgrade_steps.title: Update Apps Script
upgrade_steps.text: Add the new McpActions.gs content to your project. Set MCP_SECRET. Run mcpAuthorize once. Deploy a new version of your existing deployment.
